question.text: How will the Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa fight end on November 28, 2026?
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as the way the boxing match ends between Agit Kabayel and Nelson Hysa, currently scheduled for Saturday, November 28, 2026. Please note that "other outcome" includes any other outcome, including a Hysa victory, a draw, or the boxing match for any reason not being held before November 29, 2026 (local time).

## 1. Resolution source

- No official resolution URL is given. The outcome will come from the official result of the bout (WBC/Queensberry, DAZN broadcast, and the usual records sites).
- 2026-10-29: The DAZN background article returned HTTP 403, so I could not read it. Other sources confirm it is a WBC (not IBF) title defence. [DAZN](https://www.dazn.com/en-US/news/boxing/agit-kabayel-sets-first-ibf-defence-nelson-hysa-dusseldorf/m3q2qk73qx1b1s8ns5zb9g4iy)
- Status today: the fight is upcoming. It is scheduled for 2026-11-28 at the Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf, live on DAZN. [FanDuel](https://sportsbook.fanduel.com/boxing/boxing-matches/agit-kabayel-v-nelson-hysa-36140224)

## 2. Current status

- Nothing has happened yet that settles the question. The bout is confirmed and tickets are selling. I found no reports of injury, withdrawal or postponement as of 2026-10-29.
- 2026-10-28: Bild says more than 40,000 tickets have been sold. Henry Maske will be a DAZN pundit for the fight. [Bild](https://www.bild.de/sport/mehr-sport/boxen-tv-hammer-um-henry-maske-enthuellt-6ae2041221fd087fed7ed7e9)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)

- 2026-10-28: The fight is billed as part of German boxing's "biggest weekend". The Odiase vs. Perez card is the night before, Nov 27, in Rust. [SI](https://www.si.com/fannation/boxing/german-boxing-s-biggest-weekend-begins-with-two-european-heavyweight-title-fights)
- 2026-10-13: DAZN pundit Bernd Boente predicts "Agit wins within five rounds". He calls Kabayel a pressure fighter but warns about Hysa's counter right hand. Hysa is described as 42 with no top-tier opponents. A money dispute that delayed the deal has been resolved. [WBN](https://www.worldboxingnews.com/agit-kabayel-nelson-hysa-five-rounds/)
- 2026-10-06: More than 30,000 tickets had been sold in presale. [Fightnews](https://fightnews.com/kabayel-vs-hysa-tickets-on-sale-now-%F0%9F%94%A5/197762)
- 2026-10-02: Queensberry/Frank Warren confirmed the fight. Kabayel (34) is making his first defence of the WBC belt, which he got when Usyk vacated in June. Hysa is not ranked by the WBC and is No. 5 with the WBA. Nov 28 is Albanian independence day, so Hysa should have strong crowd support. Both fighters are with Queensberry. [The Star/Reuters](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/boxing/2026/10/02/boxing-wbc-heavyweight-champion-kabayel039s-first-defence-confirmed-for-duesseldorf-on-november-28)
- 2026-09-28: There was an earlier pullout claim, with Warren saying one side backed out. Hysa turned pro at 37 in 2022 and has mostly stopped "club-level" opponents. [Boxing News](https://boxingnews.com/news/kabayel-hysa-fight-november-dusseldorf)
- 2026-08-29: Hysa stopped Thomas Narmo in round 2 on the Itauma vs. Hrgovic card, then confronted Kabayel at ringside. [Fightmag](https://www.fightmag.com/agit-kabayel-to-face-nelson-hysa-in-germany-in-november/)
- Records: Kabayel is 27-0 (19 KOs). Hysa is 25-0 (23 KOs). [boxingscene](https://www.boxingscene.com/articles/agit-kabayel-nelson-hysa-confirmed-for-dusseldorf-on-november-28)

## 4. Base rates

Kabayel's record by fight, from [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agit_Kabayel):
- Last 6 fights (2022-2026), all stoppages:
  - Round 1: Sour
  - Round 3: Smakici, Knyba (Jan 2026)
  - Round 4: Makhmudov
  - Round 6: Zhang
  - Round 7: Sanchez
- Split of those 6 stoppages: 3 in rounds 1-3, 2 in rounds 4-6, 1 in rounds 7-12.
- Whole career: 19 of 27 wins by stoppage (70%). The other 8 were decisions: Chisora MD, Rudenko UD, Johnson UD and others. His last decision was in June 2021.
- Career stoppages by round group: 14 in rounds 1-4 (counting round 4), 1 in round 6, 3 in round 7, and 1 four-round fight ending in round 4.
- Hysa has had about four years as a pro. He has never been beyond club level and has not been tested past the early rounds against quality opposition, so his durability and stamina are unknown. A 42-year-old challenger is relevant to both stoppage chance and timing.

- Betting odds:

- I found no Polymarket or Manifold market on this fight.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution

- Fight-week press conference and weigh-in, around Nov 26-27. Watch for weight or medical problems or a late withdrawal. If the fight is not held by Nov 29, the question resolves as "Other".

# Research brief: Agit Kabayel vs. Nelson Hysa, November 28, 2026

## 1. Resolution source
- There is no official resolution URL. The outcome will be the official result of the WBC heavyweight title fight, Kabayel vs. Hysa, scheduled for 12 rounds on 2026-11-28 at the Merkur Spiel-Arena in Düsseldorf and shown live on DAZN. Early in October the event moved from a planned Oberhausen venue to Düsseldorf. BoxRec, DAZN or Ring Magazine results pages should settle it. [DAZN press](https://dazngroup.com/press-room/agit-kabayel-vs-nelson-hysa-wm-titelverteidigung-live-auf-dazn/), [boxen1](https://www.boxen1.com/kabayel-vs-hysa-ist-fix-wbc-wm-steigt-im-duesseldorfer-stadion-105606/)
- The DAZN background link returned a 403 error and I could not read it. Its URL says "IBF defence", but every other source says this is a defence of the WBC title. The IBF belt belongs to Filip Hrgovic.

## 2. Current status
- Nothing has settled the question yet. The fight is about 30 days away and still on.
- 2026-10-28: Bild reported that more than 40,000 tickets had been sold and that Henry Maske will analyse the fight for DAZN. That implies the fight was still scheduled as of yesterday. [Bild](https://www.bild.de/sport/mehr-sport/boxen-tv-hammer-um-henry-maske-enthuellt-6ae2041221fd087fed7ed7e9)
- A search turned up a "Hysa withdraws" story on a low-quality aggregator site. It most likely recycles the September dispute (see section 3). I found no reputable report of a pullout after October 1.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-10-28: The card is billed as German boxing's "biggest weekend". On 2026-11-27 Emanuel Odiase fights Mike Perez in Rust, and Kabayel vs. Hysa follows on 2026-11-28. [SI](https://www.si.com/fannation/boxing/german-boxing-s-biggest-weekend-begins-with-two-european-heavyweight-title-fights)
- 2026-10-28: Hrgovic, the IBF champion, talks about wanting to become undisputed. That points to unification fights for the Kabayel-Hysa winner in 2027. [Punch](https://punchng.com/hrgovic-sets-conditions-for-second-itauma-clash/)
- 2026-10-07: Kabayel is 27-0 with 19 KOs and Hysa is 25-0 with 23 KOs. This is Kabayel's first defence, and he will have been out about 10 months. Frank Warren cited 35,000 tickets sold plus 5,000 more added. [Ring](https://www.ringmagazine.com/news/kabayel-promises-better-version-before-hysa-defense-on-nov-28-5AhsAvDXFLlSFsyUda5HPx)
- 2026-10-06: Boxing247 says Hysa is No. 18 in the WBC rankings, outside the top 15. His recent wins over Narmo, Pesut, Korte and Castillo are weak opposition, and the outlet calls the fight one that "offers little intrigue". [Boxing247](https://www.boxing247.com/boxing-news/agit-kabayel-vs-nelson-hysa-offers-little-intrigue/310339)
- 2026-10-01/02: The fight was officially confirmed for Düsseldorf on November 28. [The Star/Reuters](https://www.thestar.com.my/sport/boxing/2026/10/02/boxing-wbc-heavyweight-champion-kabayel039s-first-defence-confirmed-for-duesseldorf-on-november-28)
- September 2026: Warren said Hysa had turned the fight down, but the deal was later revived. [boxingnews.com](https://boxingnews.com/news/kabayel-hysa-fight-november-dusseldorf/)
- 2026-09-02: Hysa stopped Thomas Narmo in round 2 on the Itauma-Hrgovic undercard (August 29), then confronted Kabayel at ringside. Sources give his age as 41 or 42, and Kabayel is described as a "ferocious body puncher". [Boxing News](https://boxingnewsonline.net/news/agit-kabayel-confronted-by-ko-artist/)
- 2026-06-27: Kabayel was elevated from interim to full WBC champion after Usyk vacated. [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agit_Kabayel)

## 4. Base rates
Kabayel's last 10 fights, from Wikipedia ([source](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Agit_Kabayel)):
- 2026-01-10: beat Knyba by TKO in round 3.
- 2025-02-22: beat Zhang by KO in round 6.
- 2024-05-18: beat Sánchez by KO in round 7.
- 2023-12-23: beat Makhmudov by TKO in round 4.
- 2023-03-04: beat Smakici by TKO in round 3.
- 2022-05-14: beat Sour by TKO in round 1.
- 2018 to 2021: four fights. He beat Rovcanin by TKO in round 3 and won three unanimous decisions (Rudenko, Lazaridis, Johnson).

What that adds up to:
- **Last 6 fights:** all stoppages. 3 were in rounds 1-3, 2 in rounds 4-6 and 1 in rounds 7-12. There were no decisions.
- **Last 10 fights:** 3 in rounds 1-3, 2 in rounds 4-6, 1 in rounds 7-12 and 3 decisions.
- **Whole career:** 19 of his 27 wins came by KO, about 70%.
- **Losses or draws:** none.

On Hysa: he has 23 KOs from 25 wins, against weak opposition, and he is around 42 years old. I found no record of him being stopped or going 12 rounds against a top-level fighter.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-10-27: DAZN Bet had Kabayel at 1.04 and Hysa at 10.0, which implies roughly 90-96% for Kabayel. I found no draw line, method-of-victory odds or round betting. [Wettbasis](https://www.wettbasis.com/sportwetten-news/kabayel-vs-hysa-datum-uhrzeit-uebertragung-tickets)
- 2026-10-29: Kalshi's "WBC Heavyweight Title on Jan 1, 2027" market had Kabayel at 0.82. This is related but not the same question, and the prices look inconsistent: Itauma shows 0.79 and Fury 0.30, so the options add up to well over 1.
- I found no Polymarket or Manifold market and no published expert method picks. Boxing247 expects a one-sided fight.

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- Fight week in late November: the final press conference and weigh-in, where any injury withdrawal or replacement opponent would show up. Hysa has backed out once before, in September, and Warren had promised a replacement opponent at that time.
- 2026-11-27: the Odiase-Perez card in Rust, the night before.
- 2026-11-28: the fight itself, with the main event unofficially reported for around 22:00 local time. That leaves a small chance of timing issues against the November 29 local-time deadline. [box.live](https://box.live/fights/kabayel-vs-hysa/)
